start.instruction: Clean the currently carried grimy guam leaves. Noting, unnoting and acquisition are outside this record.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level required to clean guam; reaching level 3 also follows the mandatory Druidic Ritual unlock.

freeInventorySlots.description: Cleaning replaces one non-stackable grimy herb with one non-stackable clean herb, so the declared batch needs no extra ordinary slot.

consumes.description: One currently carried grimy guam leaf for one cleaning action.

produces.basis: One clean guam leaf per carried grimy guam leaf cleaned.

stopConditions.description: Stop when no carried grimy guam remains.

costs.assumptions: Uses only the currently carried herb. No acquisition, noting, disposal or storage value is inferred.

methods.reason: Processes a carried herb immediately while preserving occupied-slot count; the low per-action XP is retained as source context, not converted into a claimed hourly rate.

sources.notes: Reviewed current UIM guidance for cleaning carried herbs and the inventory pressure of Herblore.
Reviewed level 3, 2.5 experience, and the grimy-to-clean guam transformation. Both exact forms are non-stackable.

requirements.description: At least one current carried herb supports the conservative single-action profile.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Coarse editorial efficiency for direct cleaning of already-carried guam. No hourly rate is claimed.

methods.displayName: Convert carried 4-dose super energies to staminas

start.instruction: Use four carried amylase crystals on one carried 4-dose super energy potion.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level required to make stamina potions.

freeInventorySlots.description: The stamina output reuses the consumed super-energy position; amylase remains one shared stack unless exhausted.

consumes.description: Four carried amylase crystals for the four doses.

produces.basis: One 4-dose stamina potion per four-dose conversion.

stopConditions.description: Pause when fewer than four carried amylase crystals remain.

costs.assumptions: No decanting, agility acquisition, noting or chained super-energy production is assumed. Exact carried 4-dose inputs only.

methods.reason: Exercises a verified stack quantity without treating four crystals as four slots; the carried super-energy slot becomes the output slot.

sources.notes: Reviewed the level 77 UIM stamina guidance and the explicit statement that amylase crystals stack.
Reviewed one crystal per dose, four crystals for a 4-dose conversion, level 77 and 102 total experience.

requirements.description: One exact carried 4-dose super energy potion.
Four current amylase crystals in their one shared stack.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Conservative direct conversion profile. It excludes decanting and carries no hourly XP estimate.

produces.basis: One processed Mammoth-Might potion for the verified order.

stopConditions.description: Stop when Mammoth-Might is no longer a current order and refresh order state.
